instruction: Cinematic wide shot of a dance studio with a dark wall and wooden floor. In the foreground right, a bearded man in a brown shirt (R1) on hands and knees supports a woman with a hair bun in a yellow shirt (R2) balancing horizontally on his back with arms spread. In the background left, a short-haired man in a brown shirt (R3) on hands and knees supports a woman with a ponytail in a yellow shirt (R4) balancing on his back. Warm spotlight from the top right casts soft shadows on the floor.
